'''Star Tours Flight 705''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Elshandruu Pica]]. At the time of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight had recently arrived at the spaceport's Gate 1C at 0615 hours. The gate was then closed in preparation for the flight's departure at 0710.
